function.name: research_plan
function.description: Record hypothesis and owned candidate in diagnose; optionally choose next_research_action to load its scientific interface. Selection executes nothing. Main chooses variables, effort and subsequent actions. Original Plan and independent acceptance gates apply.

EvidenceRef.description: Use the stable short reference in the research packet or an evidence response.

claimed_inference.description: Use empirical_search for a proposed experiment, including testing a prediction in physics. Unsupported stronger claims remain annotated hypotheses and do not veto an otherwise legal experiment. Formal conclusions and SELECT/CONFIRM/STOP still require registered scoped evidence; execution always requires valid identity, authorization, applicability and budget.

selected_method.description: Optional action intent label; no solver name is required. The scientific question selects semantics after diagnose.

selected_candidate.description: Required for execute/initialize_control/control_search/physical_replay. Match candidate, control_seed.candidate, control_search.candidate or physical_replay.candidate respectively; never substitute the control source. For diagnose, place the owned candidate here at decision.selected_candidate; there is no top-level selected_candidate field.

requested_budget.description: Declared request cap, not actual cost or authorization. For Plan control_search match settings.evaluation_requests (physical replay callbacks); otherwise declared operation units. Zero independent physical evaluations does not imply zero Native integration. Missing formal scope and unknown costs remain unresolved until normal admission.

next_research_action.description: Diagnose only, explicit scientific action Study: explicitly choose the next scientific interface. Loads its Schema only; does not execute or choose variables/budget. Omit to keep action discovery neutral.

experience_disposition.description: Only actual experience_retrieve read receipt IDs or exact entry_id@revision keys. Omit when experience retrieval is unavailable; scientific artifact IDs and hypothesis names are not experience keys.

parameters.description: Submit the selected diagnose action. All original Plan validation and evidence admission apply. hypothesis is required; probe completion is not scientific STOP.

function.name: experience_retrieve
function.description: Search curated procedural guidance, then execute a result entry read_query exactly. A retrieval receipt artifact ID is not an entry_id. Historical guidance never grants scientific evidence or action permission.

limit.description: Optional search result count. Omit to return all authorized metadata. Exact reads identify one entry/revision.
limit.title: Limit

function.name: evidence_read
function.description: Read a named missing fact using exact evidence and JSON pointer. For ordinary Reporter investigation, use compact findings or view=summary on the report; then use fields/range or interpretation_query for needed detail. Full reads remain available for formal SELECT/STOP requirements. Delegate explanation to research_investigate.

pointer.description: Absolute JSON Pointer; use summary to discover child keys. Permanent Store references survive session handoff; temporary SDK offload references do not.

function.description: Recall saved research by stable step number, or page through history. Details support precise JSON Pointers. Navigation grants no formal SELECT/STOP evidence credit.

step.title: Step

pointer.description: JSON Pointer relative to the original Plan or tool feedback result; details only.
pointer.title: Pointer

function.description: Select a tool and action; load its Schema on the next request. No scientific execution or evidence credit.

action.description: Exact Plan action or RL operation from the directory; omit for other tools.
action.title: Action

parameters.title: ResearchRouteQuery
parameters.description: Choose one tool and its Plan action or RL operation from tool_directory. Selection performs no scientific execution. The loaded tool can be reused; call research_route to switch.

function.name: research_analysis
function.description: Submit a scientific question for the candidate and hypothesis in the completed diagnose Plan. Deterministic compilation preserves original execution admission and charges; unsupported semantics are never replaced.

EvidenceRef.description: Use the stable short reference in the research packet or an evidence response.

goal.title: Goal
goal.description: Main explicitly chooses increase or decrease for differentiation or optimization.

mode.description: C2 finite search parameterization: full_task adjusts all tendon channels with two independent endpoint knots over the frozen task; time_window adjusts all channels with one triangular pulse per channel and zero endpoint corrections. Choose a scope only when this parameterization answers the question; arbitrary waveform or channel-subset search is not adapted.

window_s.description: Only control corrections inside this interval; evaluation still covers the complete frozen task.

t1_results.description: Comparable saved Native T1 results, baseline first; may select explicit shared-baseline paths/scales. No new search is requested.

parameter_group.description: Actual capability category; segment_lengths is retained as a legacy selector.

requested_budget.description: Maximum original mathematical evaluations for this question. Mechanism cost depends on selected paths, central/one-sided stencils and bounded local search. Research the frozen passive assembly through mechanism_research. Choose load conditions, constrained observables, legal physical parameters and finite mathematical effort. Compare constrained motion and load compliance. Decide whether evidence supports a structural proposal; only you choose whether to generate it. Passive independent dynamic acceptance is not registered; do not claim SELECT eligibility. Use English.
Write all research decisions and tool arguments directly in English. Scientific records and reports must originate in English.
For the current interface, the advertised selected-tool Schema takes precedence over earlier parameter examples. Use stable short references from the current packet. Supply only advertised fields; the host binds omitted family identity, candidate/control lineage and repeated evidence fields. Keep scientific hypotheses, direction, effort and adoption decisions explicit. Structural inspect/differentiate/optimize/compare use research_analysis after diagnose; joint structure-control search uses research_plan(search).

function.name: research_plan
function.description: Record hypothesis and owned candidate in diagnose; optionally choose next_research_action to load its scientific interface. Selection executes nothing. Main chooses variables, effort and subsequent actions. Original Plan and independent acceptance gates apply.

EvidenceRef.description: Use the stable short reference in the research packet or an evidence response.

GenerationRequestV2.description: Supply only intended design changes. Omitted optional overrides inherit frozen defaults/prototypes; sections and cells need not be filled. Valid generation does not establish task success.

claimed_inference.description: Use empirical_search for a proposed experiment, including testing a prediction in physics. Unsupported stronger claims remain annotated hypotheses and do not veto an otherwise legal experiment. Formal conclusions and SELECT/CONFIRM/STOP still require registered scoped evidence; execution always requires valid identity, authorization, applicability and budget.

selected_method.description: Optional action intent label; no solver name is required. The scientific question selects semantics after diagnose.

selected_candidate.description: Required for execute/initialize_control/control_search/physical_replay. Match candidate, control_seed.candidate, control_search.candidate or physical_replay.candidate respectively; never substitute the control source. For diagnose, place the owned candidate here at decision.selected_candidate; there is no top-level selected_candidate field.

requested_budget.description: Declared request cap, not actual cost or authorization. For Plan control_search match settings.evaluation_requests (physical replay callbacks); otherwise declared operation units. Zero independent physical evaluations does not imply zero Native integration. Missing formal scope and unknown costs remain unresolved until normal admission.

sections.description: Optional override. Omit unchanged sections; otherwise match the exact count and order of the selected prototype stations shown in generation_inputs.

cells.description: Optional override within frozen cell_count_bounds; omit to inherit default_cells.

angular_offsets_rad.description: Extra offsets: theta_j = phase_rad + 2*pi*j/count + angular_offsets_rad[j]. Empty uses equal spacing. These are not absolute angles.

experience_disposition.description: Only actual experience_retrieve read receipt IDs or exact entry_id@revision keys. Omit when experience retrieval is unavailable; scientific artifact IDs and hypothesis names are not experience keys.

parameters.description: Submit the selected generate action. All original Plan validation and evidence admission apply. hypothesis is required; probe completion is not scientific STOP.

function.name: experience_retrieve
function.description: Search curated procedural guidance, then execute a result entry read_query exactly. A retrieval receipt artifact ID is not an entry_id. Historical guidance never grants scientific evidence or action permission.

limit.description: Optional search result count. Omit to return all authorized metadata. Exact reads identify one entry/revision.
limit.title: Limit

function.name: evidence_read
function.description: Read a named missing fact using exact evidence and JSON pointer. For ordinary Reporter investigation, use compact findings or view=summary on the report; then use fields/range or interpretation_query for needed detail. Full reads remain available for formal SELECT/STOP requirements. Delegate explanation to research_investigate.

EvidenceRef.description: Use the stable short reference in the research packet or an evidence response.

pointer.description: Absolute JSON Pointer; use summary to discover child keys. Permanent Store references survive session handoff; temporary SDK offload references do not.
pointer.title: Pointer

fields.description: Immediate child keys at an object pointer, not dotted paths. Use with view=fields for raw JSON, or with view=working_set/mathematical_capabilities to select fields inside that derived view. For a working_set list select a row by /control_result_links/<index> first; do not switch to raw view=fields for derived paths.
fields.title: Fields

function.name: research_recall
function.description: Recall saved research by stable step number, or page through history. Details support precise JSON Pointers. Navigation grants no formal SELECT/STOP evidence credit.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer relative to the original Plan or tool feedback result; details only.
pointer.title: Pointer

step.description: Stable Store step number. Omit to page through the trace.
step.title: Step

function.name: research_route
function.description: Select a tool and action; load its Schema on the next request. No scientific execution or evidence credit.

action.description: Exact Plan action or RL operation from the directory; omit for other tools.
action.title: Action

parameters.title: ResearchRouteQuery
parameters.description: Choose one tool and its Plan action or RL operation from tool_directory. Selection performs no scientific execution. The loaded tool can be reused; call research_route to switch.

function.name: research_investigate
function.description: Read-only investigation of saved results: provide a question and result references; exact reads and authorized experience_queries are optional. No candidate is needed to read existing evidence. This does not execute research_plan(diagnose) or candidate-bound research_analysis. Returns compact findings and an interpretation_query; internal reads give no SELECT/STOP credit.

pointer.description: Absolute JSON Pointer; use summary to discover child keys. Permanent Store references survive session handoff; temporary SDK offload references do not.
pointer.title: Pointer

fields.description: Immediate child keys at an object pointer, not dotted paths. Use with view=fields for raw JSON, or with view=working_set/mathematical_capabilities to select fields inside that derived view. For a working_set list select a row by /control_result_links/<index> first; do not switch to raw view=fields for derived paths.
fields.title: Fields

EvidenceRef.description: Use the stable short reference in the research packet or an evidence response.

limit.description: Optional search result count. Omit to return all authorized metadata. Exact reads identify one entry/revision.
limit.title: Limit

reads.description: Delegate detailed evidence reading here: exact fields/range/JSON Pointer reads, including working_set /diagnostic_relations; never formal reading credit
reads.title: Reads

experience_queries.description: Optional curated procedural search/exact read. Guidance only; never scientific sources or formal reading credit.
experience_queries.title: Experience Queries
